label: pjm 53 zonal gas
definition: (REJECTED PROBE; pjm-48 stays keeper) pjm-52 coal-bit sticky stack base (verbatim) + ONE new structural lever, pjm_zonal_gas_basis. Shifts each PJM gas unit by its zone's MEASURED EIA delivered-to-electric-power gas basis vs Henry Hub (series N3045<ST>3M by the zone's primary state -- IL/OH/OH/WV/PA/VA/NJ/MD for ComEd/AEP_Ohio/ATSI/West_APS/Central_PA/Dominion/EMAAC/SWMAAC; data/raw/pjm_zonal_gas_hub.csv), a forward-reproducible measured series, anchored to a gas-capacity-weighted mean of ZERO so the calibrated PJM fleet-aggregate gas level is byte-preserved and ONLY the cross-zonal spread opens (west coal belt cheap, EMAAC/SWMAAC/Dominion dear; coal-sigmoid reference left on the ISO mean). HYPOTHESIS (task pjm-53): dear-east gas -> eastern zones import cheap western power -> Central_PA->EMAAC / SWMAAC->EMAAC TTCs bind -> eastern LMP separates up, fixing the +54 TWh eastern CC over-run, the -15 coal under-run, the under-priced LMP (C3a 2024 -10.9%) and the +63 over-export in one lever. RESULT -- FALSIFIED: the lever is structurally correct but INERT. The zonal LMP spread is EXACTLY $0.00 in all 8760 hours of all three years (perfect copper-plate, unchanged from pjm-52), and the dispatch is within noise (2024 COAL_BIT 97.2 vs 96.6, net export +61.0 vs +63.0; gas-CC still +11.3/+17.2/+16.9% over, COAL_BIT -15.4/-13.0/-3.3% under, LMP -3.9/-10.4/-14.4% under, interchange +49.3/+61.0/+57.8 vs actual +40.0/+32.7/+18.0). DIAGNOSIS -- the PJM copper-plate is a reduced-NETWORK artifact, not a gas-pricing one: the priced PJM_external node is a single price hub wired to 5 of 8 zones with ~30 GW of uncongested transfer (4.9-7.5 GW each) and the internal TTCs (3-8 GW) are loose relative to flows, so even a real $0.47-0.87/MMBtu dear-east/cheap-west gas spread (~$3-6/MWh at the burner tip) makes NO link bind -- cheap western supply floods east and to the export hub unconstrained and ties every zone's energy-balance dual to one price. The zonal gas lever is measured, flow-blind, forward-reproducible market structure and is correct to keep once the network congests (rule #1), but it is NOT the lever for the binding constraint. NEXT: tighten the PJM TTCs / rework the external star node (verify against PJM Data Miner interface binding frequency) so the network actually congests, THEN the zonal gas basis can separate the LMP. C6 PASS. Years 2023-25, single-process sequential solve.
